paragraphs: R. Chanina Choznaah, in Rav Nachman's time. Gid HaNasheh has Chozaah. Eruvin 32a; Pesachim 9a; Bava Metzia 88a; Yevamot 111b; Avodah Zarah 41b, near the end; Niddah 15b. He said to Rabbah: Shabbat 130b, near the end. See Rav Chanin of Mechoza above.
